**Conflicts and gaps**
- **#8841 descriptions differ.**
  - On 7/1 Gideon said he closed it (kiosk tablet cache issue / Detention Summary export).
  - The 4/27 digest calls it #PD-8841, about missed carrier check-ins at Allentown Gate 4.
  - The 5/4 digest says it was still open for an Allentown kiosk timeout at Dock Door 12.
  - The 9/30 digest says Mateo submitted it for a Newark Dock Door 14 kiosk problem.
  
  It may be one ticket reopened or the number reused. Please confirm in the ticketing system before the steering committee.
- **#PD-4418 is a probable match.** The digest says only "the account Nadia runs", not Vantorre by name. Please confirm it belongs to Vantorre Group.
- **Hartford tickets aren't linked.** I couldn't confirm whether INC-4821 and VT-55120 are the same issue. Gideon only says VT-55120 is the root cause of the outage.
- **Unticketed issues.**
  - Door 14 duplicate arrival entries: 5/3 and 5/4 digests ("existing support thread").
  - Appointment-board door assignments disappearing: 8/3 digest.
  - Gate check-in delays: 3/10/2025 digest (Mateo's email).
  - Neither the 7/7/2025, 12/1/2025 nor cheat-sheet digest has a Vantorre Group ticket.

This covers only these three sources. It isn't the full ticket system history.
